question: Do Tranche's equipment valuation assumptions match public resale and useful-life data?

tranche.source: src/modules/equipment-finance/scoring.ts calculateMetrics, constants.ts EQUIPMENT_DEFAULTS and FACTOR_TARGETS, Deal_Screening_Model_Assumptions.md sections 3 and term coverage
tranche.usedHaircut: Used equipment valued at 85% of stated cost (15% haircut). Read as the gap between the price paid and forced-sale value.
tranche.newHaircut: New equipment valued at 100% of cost (0% haircut).
tranche.conditionBonus: New equipment also gets +12 points on the LTV factor (scoring.ts). Used gets the haircut and no bonus.
tranche.termCoverageLimit: Loan term above 80% of useful life is weak (maxTermCoverage 80).
tranche.usefulLifeRanges: EQUIPMENT_DEFAULTS.usefulLifeRange per equipment type, shown to the analyst as a hint. The analyst enters useful life.

joel.note: Written before any resale data was shown. Joel declined to give numeric expectations: he does not have the experience to give numbers he would trust.
joel.usedHaircut: No view on whether 15% is right.
joel.newHaircut: Directional: 0% is not enough for new equipment.
joel.conditionBonus: Double penalty on used equipment might be overkill, but is not necessarily inaccurate.
